regions.summary: Minquan county with part of Ningling and a bit of Cao county (Shandong).

candidates.name: Minquan
candidates.meaning: "People's rights", a 1914 county name taken from Sun Yat-sen's Principle of Democracy.
candidates.fit: 66% of the people, region holds 94% of the county.

candidates.name: Kaocheng
candidates.meaning: Old county town, seat for 1,592 years (Zi county, Han era to Qing 1777), northeast of Minquan.
candidates.fit: Its seat lies in this region; territory is roughly today's Minquan north part.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article (考城縣), 133 hits with 河南, mostly about this place.
candidates.source_note: 治所在今河南省民權縣東北

candidates.name: Yucheng
candidates.meaning: "Yu town": Yu was the fief of Shun's son Shangjun, said to lie here; county since 596.
candidates.fit: 92% of the people, region holds 87% of the county.
candidates.source_note: 舜之子商均……封于虞地(今河南虞城)

regions.summary: Zhecheng county and the rural south of Suiyang district (Shangqiu).

candidates.name: Zhecheng
candidates.meaning: "Mulberry-wood town" (zhe is the cudrania/silkworm thorn tree); county since 621, Zhe county before.
candidates.fit: 58% of the people, region holds 75% of the county.

candidates.name: Suiyang
candidates.meaning: "Sui River's north bank"; the old name of Shangqiu's centre and its current district.
candidates.fit: 40% of the people but only rural parts of the district; the city core lies outside this region.

regions.summary: Fugou county plus the western half of Taikang and bits of Qi and Weishi.

candidates.name: Fugou
candidates.meaning: County named for the Fu watercourse (gou, ditch); a county for about 2,000 years since 202 BC.
candidates.fit: 43% of the people, region holds 86% of the county.

regions.notes: Taikang is split between 6 and 7; I gave Taikang to 7, which holds the county seat.

regions.summary: Central Taikang, with Sui and Zhecheng edges.

candidates.name: Taikang
candidates.meaning: Named for Tai Kang, a Xia king said to have moved his capital here; county since 587 (Yangxia before).
candidates.fit: 57% of the people, region holds the county seat (half the county).
candidates.source_note: 夏王太康迁都于此，故称阳夏

regions.notes: Yangxia, the old name, was checked and rejected: it is better known as the Wuhan (Hankou) battle name.

regions.summary: Luyi county with the Anhui side (Qiaocheng district edge, Bozhou).

candidates.name: Luyi
candidates.meaning: "Deer town"; county since 1271, earlier Ku, Guyang and Zhenyuan; traditional birthplace of Laozi.
candidates.fit: 54% of the people, region holds 63% of the county; Anhui part is the Bozhou side, which the map names Bozhou separately.
candidates.source_note: 鹿邑县 (县, 1271-1911), seats list in sources.md

regions.summary: Huaiyang district and part of Luyi and Taikang; the old Chenzhou seat.

candidates.name: Huaiyang
candidates.meaning: "North of the Huai": Han kingdom of Huaiyang (196 BC); the county was also called Chen, Wanqiu and Huaining.
candidates.fit: 61% of the people, region holds 63% of the county and the old Chen seat.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; seat of Chen state, Chen prefecture and Chen commandery for over 2,000 years.

candidates.name: Chen
candidates.meaning: Zhou-era state of the Gui clan (descendants of Shun), capital Wanqiu at Huaiyang.
candidates.fit: Capital is in this region; the state covered most of Zhoukou.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; one-word pinyin collides with the surname Chen.
candidates.source_note: 陳建都宛丘（今河南淮陽城關一帶）

regions.notes: Chenzhou not offered: Chenzhou in Hunan is far better known. Wanqiu has only 26 hits and no article.

regions.summary: Xihua county with parts of Shangshui and Zhaoling (Luohe).

candidates.name: Xihua
candidates.meaning: "West Hua"; the county dates from 202 BC, from the Han Xihua town on the Ying River.
candidates.fit: 64% of the people, region holds 97% of the county.

candidates.name: Dancheng
candidates.meaning: "Dan town"; county formed in 1965 from parts of Luyi, Huaiyang and others.
candidates.fit: 98% of the people, region holds 98% of the county.

regions.summary: Zhoukou city centre: Chuanhui district and the Shangshui county seat.

candidates.name: Zhoukou
candidates.meaning: "Zhou family's landing": a Zhou family opened the first ferry on the Sha River here (Zhoujiakou).
candidates.fit: Holds the old centre (Chuanhui, 79% of the people); the prefecture is named after this city.

regions.notes: Zhoukou has about 0.5M urban people in Chuanhui alone, so the region fits the city-centre rule by being the old centre.

regions.summary: Xiangcheng city (county level) and the eastern half of Huaiyang.

candidates.name: Xiangcheng
candidates.meaning: "Xiang town": from the ancient Xiang state, an old county town.
candidates.fit: 62% of the people, region holds 63% of the city.

candidates.name: Shenqiu
candidates.meaning: "Shen mound": named for the ancient Shen state's hill, a county since the Sui dynasty.
candidates.fit: 92% of the people, region holds 97% of the county.

regions.summary: Shangqiu city core: Liangyuan and Suiyang urban districts, holding the old Song and Guide centre.

candidates.name: Shangqiu
candidates.meaning: "Hill of Shang": Ahbo, fire officer of Tao Tang, lived at Shangqiu; site of the Shang people's roots.
candidates.fit: Holds Shangqiu's old centre (Suiyang old city, Liangyuan); city rule names the central region after the city.
candidates.recognisability: Prefecture-level city, national historic city, own zh-wiki article.
candidates.source_note: 因陶唐氏（帝尧）封帝喾子契（阏伯）为火正于此，又地应商星，故曰“商丘”

regions.summary: West of Shangqiu: Ningling county, western Liangyuan and Sui county, on the Yellow River old course plain.

candidates.name: Ningling
candidates.meaning: County since 122 BC; earlier Ning city of Song, then Xinling under Wei.
candidates.fit: Largest unit (35% of people), holds 70% of the county; Liangyuan (30%) and Sui (24%) are the rest.
candidates.source_note: 公元前122年，西汉武帝置宁陵县

candidates.name: Xiangyi
candidates.meaning: Qin county at today's Sui county, later Gongzhou and Suizhou seat.
candidates.fit: Seat of Sui county (24% of people) only; Ningling is bigger.
candidates.recognisability: Only 28 zh-wiki hits with Shangqiu, mostly about Sui county.
candidates.source_note: 襄邑升为拱州；睢州治所在襄邑县（今河南省睢县）
